findings.title: Empty-build detection uses claimed paths instead of the approved all-paths definition
findings.specimen: commit 62bb4144dc49b05dab6c742651bee05fe2007777; attavo/build.py::build_is_empty, consumed by attavo/build.py, attavo/verify.py, and attavo/doctor.py
findings.retires: The claim-scoped replacement for the approved definition of an empty build; restores comparison of the approval tree to the recorded build tree across every path except paths.records.
findings.severity: Blocking whenever approval..build changes only paths outside the spec's claims and outside paths.records: the approved predicate reports a non-empty build, while build_is_empty reports empty and build halts, verify refuses, and proof seven fails it.

findings.title: Criteria are executed from the executor's working tree, not from the detached gate checkout
findings.specimen: attavo/build.py:607, which passes spec_dir / "criteria" / name from the original root to run_criterion while using gate_root only as cwd
findings.retires: The remaining working-tree read in the build gate; closes the ability for an executor's uncommitted edit to a criterion executable to determine the gate result.
findings.severity: Blocking when the executor leaves an uncommitted modification to a criterion and commits any otherwise non-empty claimed change: the detached checkout supplies the cwd, but the modified criterion outside it is executed and can turn a committed criterion failure into a pass.
